name: Fiji Museum
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage See lists it as the place to understand Fiji's history, 3,700-year-old artefacts, paid entry.
objection: Single counted source; but the only See entry in Suva and a national museum.

name: Thurston Gardens
reason: Wikivoyage names the botanical garden only as a place to sit with takeaway; a stroll beside the museum.
objection: For: Fiji's botanical garden, free, next to the museum. Against: one passing mention, no listing of its own.

name: Suva Municipal Market
reason: Rule 4: daily (Mon-Sat) market hall with produce, Wikivoyage listing; a daily market hall qualifies.
objection: One source and mainly local produce shopping.

name: Suva Fish Market
reason: Daily Mon-Sat fish stalls in town centre, one Wikivoyage listing.
objection: For: daily market, colourful. Against: near-duplicate of the municipal market cluster, short visit.

name: Municipal Handicraft Centre
reason: Rule 2: a shopping venue of souvenir stalls, not a distinct draw.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it, and it is a daily hall, but it is a shop row.

name: Sacred Heart Cathedral, Suva
reason: Church rule: no visitor source names anything to see inside; Wikipedia only.
objection: Cathedral may have notable architecture, but no counted source.

name: Albert Park
reason: Rule 3-4: Wikivoyage mentions it only as a venue for matches (events), no permanent draw.
objection: A central park, free to enter.

name: Suva Waterfront
reason: Rule 3: promenade with no separate attraction, per the note; only a place to eat takeaway.
objection: A harbour walk could be a half hour; no source calls it a sight.

name: Colo-i-Suva Forest Reserve
reason: Rule 1-2: Lonely Planet lists Colo-i-Suva Forest Park; rainforest trails, pools and Waisila Falls, a standard Suva half-day (LP page returned only its heading, Wikivoyage Suva also routes through it).
objection: Reserve is an area rather than a point; park charges entry. Still a named walk-and-swim destination.

name: Mount Korobaba
reason: Rule 1-2: Lonely Planet best-hikes article (5.6 km return, 360 degree views of Suva) plus Fiji Pocket Guide and fiji.travel hike pages; a 3-hour summit walk.
objection: A real viewpoint walk above Lami, but the only source is a blog.

name: Lami
reason: No counted source names a stop in the town.
objection: Gateway to Korobaba walk only.

name: Kula WILD Adventure Park
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Coral Coast says 'don't miss' Kula EcoPark; paid wildlife park with birds, iguanas, turtles and a botanic garden.
objection: Single counted source; family-oriented attraction.

name: Hot Glass Fiji
reason: Wikivoyage Sigatoka lists a glassblowing studio where visitors watch and make glass; Tue-Fri only.
objection: For: a hands-on activity. Against: small business, one source, set days.

name: Sunset Strip
reason: Rule 2-3: a strip of resorts and restaurants, dining and stay area only.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it under See, but it offers nothing to do beyond eating.

name: Pacific Harbour
reason: Rule 3: a resort town; its draws are the Arts Village and shark dive, judged separately. A town wrapper is not a spot.
objection: Wikivoyage calls it Fiji's adventure capital and the closest tourist beach to Suva.

name: Arts Village
reason: Two Wikivoyage pages: craft shops, cultural centre, firewalking shows in Pacific Harbour (Wikivoyage Pacific Harbour opened).
objection: For: two counted sources, hours to browse. Against: mainly a shopping/eating village and shows are scheduled.

name: Beqa Shark Reef
reason: Rule 1-2: Rough Guides (Beqa Lagoon shark dives, renowned worldwide) plus Wikivoyage Pacific Harbour (shark reef designated marine park); the reef is the place, dive operators only access it.
objection: For: world-known dive. Against: reachable only on operator dives, one source, and it is the operator's listing.

name: Beqa
reason: No counted source found for the island (Wikivoyage Beqa page is a stub).
objection: Reef and villages exist but no visitor source names a stop.

name: Navua River
reason: Rule 1-2: Rough Guides (explore the Navua River) plus Fodor's and Traveller.com.au on Upper Navua Gorge rafting; Wikipedia notes Upper Navua Conservation Area. The river gorge is the place.
objection: For: a signature gorge trip. Against: only reachable on operator trips, source unconfirmed.

name: Namosi Highlands
reason: Rule 3: a broad interior area, no distinct stop.
objection: Village visits and kava mentioned by one source.

name: Navua
reason: No counted source; gateway town with no stop of its own.
objection: Base for Navua River trips.

name: Nausori
reason: Wikivoyage Nausori names no stop of the town itself, only places nearby.
objection: Fourth largest town, but not a sightseeing stop.

name: Rewa Bridge
reason: Rule 2: seen by crossing it; nothing to do.
objection: Wikivoyage names it as a place to visit.

name: Naq Kuti Mandir
reason: Rule 2: a place of worship with no named feature to see.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it.

name: Naililili Cathedral
reason: Church rule: Wikivoyage lists it with no interior or feature named.
objection: Historic cathedral.

name: Bau Beach
reason: Rule 3: a local beach with a bare one-line listing.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it.

name: Bau
reason: No counted source found in Wikivoyage for the island; Wikipedia only.
objection: Historic seat of the Bauan chiefs; may be visited by tours; re-check in a later pass.

name: Nausori Highlands
reason: Wikivoyage region page: nature walks, hikes, off-road tours, village of Navala.
objection: For: cultural highlands with its own page. Against: a region, outline article, no single stop (Navala would be the spot).

name: Mount Tomanivi
reason: Rule 1-2: Rough Guides (Mount Victoria, Fiji highest point, half-day guided hike, village fee) plus Wikipedia body describing the summit trail; Navai village guides.
objection: Fiji's highest peak, but Wikivoyage only mentions it in passing.

name: Korovou
reason: Town with no stop of its own named.
objection: Wikivoyage names it as a place to visit.
